title_sq: Tek Eterna Tirana, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!!
description_sq: Tek Eterna Tirana, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt!! Prona ndodhet ne katin e 4-te dhe organizohet ne korridorin, sallonin ndenjes me kendin e gatimit, dhoma e gjumit me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti. Apartamenti shitet bashke me nje post parkimi ne -2 me cmim ekstra (25.000 euro). Eterna Tirana eshte nje nga projektet me elitare ne qytetin e Tiranes dhe konceptohet si një landmark urban, ku arkitektura krijon një marrëdhënie të drejtpërdrejtë me dritën dhe qytetin. Fasada ndjek ciklin e diellit gjatë ditës, duke theksuar ritmin dhe qartësinë e ndërtesës.
title_en: At Eterna Tirana, 1+1 Apartment For Sale, With Regular Layout!!
description_en: At Eterna Tirana, 1+1 Apartment For Sale With Regular Layout!! The property is located on the 4th floor and is organized in the corridor, living room with kitchenette, bedroom with access to the balcony and toilet. The apartment is sold together with a parking space in -2 at an extra price (25,000 euros). Eterna Tirana is one of the most elite projects in the city of Tirana and is conceived as an urban landmark, where architecture creates a direct relationship with light and the city. The facade follows the cycle of the sun during the day, emphasizing the rhythm and clarity of the building.
